text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being told exactly what to do. In supervised learning, we give a computer training data that includes both examples and correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model, which is like a set of rules it has learned. Once the model is ready, it can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, it might predict whether an email is spam or not. We check the model's accuracy by comparing its predictions with the real answers. The better the training data, the more accurate the predictions usually are.
